topics.label: Course Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the cancer biology lecture series, its multidisciplinary audience, and the key learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Cancer as a Disruption of Cellular Differentiation and Tissue Architecture
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define cancer as a failure of normal developmental differentiation and genetic control, discussing how these changes alter tissue architecture and how researchers attempt to model them in vitro.

topics.label: Invasion, Metastasis, and Histological Progression of Tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the clinical and histological distinction between benign and malignant tumors, using the colorectal adenoma-to-carcinoma sequence to demonstrate how invasiveness and metastatic spread develop.

topics.label: Tumor Nomenclature and Classification
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the standard conventions and notable exceptions for naming tumors based on their tissue of origin and malignant potential.

topics.label: Pathophysiological Mechanisms of Cancer Morbidity and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes how primary mass effects, organ obstruction, bone erosion, and widespread metastatic colonization cause severe illness and death.

topics.label: Comparative Cancer Incidence Across Humans and Other Species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics review epidemiological frequencies of major human tumor types and compare cancer occurrence across domestic animals and diverse multicellular organisms.

topics.label: Clinical Principles and Organ-Specific Modalities of Cancer Screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the rationale, effectiveness, and limitations of screening programs for detecting pre-malignant and early-stage cancers across different anatomical sites.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Practical Preparation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by reiterating the core learning outcomes and pointing forward to upcoming practical sessions.
